Notification access
So XDesk can show the phone\'s notifications on the external screen. They stay in memory only: never stored, never sent anywhere.
On the next page, find XDesk and turn its switch on
Switch greyed out? On the app details page, tap ⋮ at the top right → “Allow restricted settings”
Autostart

The notification service is not connected, most likely because the phone does not let XDesk start itself, so no notifications come in. If it stays like this with Autostart on, turn notification access off and on again.
Turn XDesk on in the list on the next page; it is also under Settings › Apps › XDesk
The system has not connected XDesk\'s notification service yet. Turn XDesk\'s switch off and on again.
Do Not Disturb access
So the Do Not Disturb switch on the external screen can set the phone\'s, like the one in Quick Settings.
Notifications
So you can type the pairing code right in XDesk\'s notification, without switching between pages.
While a desktop runs, one notification stays; tap it to come back to XDesk. Works without it too.
Not required: open XDesk in split screen or a floating window and type it on its page
Display over other apps
So the clock can cover the external screen while it is locked.
So this screen can show the launcher. Until then, choose apps on the phone.
On the next page, turn on “Allow display over other apps”
Run commands in Termux
So XDesk can start and end desktops in Termux for you, and list Termux\'s environments.
The system asks you next
Refused before: allow “Run commands in Termux environment” under App details › Permissions › Additional permissions. Or run xdesk start in Termux yourself
Camera
To scan the QR code Sill shows on the Mac. Without it, go back and add the Mac by address.
The system asks you next
Refused before: allow the camera under App details › Permissions
Shizuku permission
USB tethering as NCM
Run this on a computer and it is set:\nadb shell settings put global tether_force_usb_functions 1
XDesk may not change this system setting itself; adb on a computer can set it directly.

Injector service
Keys and mouse for Android apps · wireless debugging
Android apps on the external screen get their keys and mouse from here: wireless debugging pairing, or Shizuku.
Android apps open but cannot be controlled; Linux desktops and screen mirroring still work.
Tap Activate below\nTurn on wireless debugging and type the pairing code\nXDesk connects when you come back; Shizuku works too
Cursor, launcher, home and privacy cover on the external screen
The launcher and home on the external screen\nCovering the external screen when you leave XDesk
No cursor on the external screen; no launcher either, so apps are chosen on the phone; the privacy cover cannot show.
Tap Turn on below\nTurn on “Allow display over other apps”\nCome back to XDesk; it checks by itself
Type the pairing code in the notification
The pairing code is shown in XDesk\'s notification, so you do not switch between pages.
You can still type the pairing code on XDesk\'s page.
Tap Turn on below\nAllow XDesk to send notifications\nThe pairing code then appears in the notification
Phone notifications on the external screen
Nothing from the phone shows on the external screen; everything else works as before. Nothing is stored or sent.
Tap Turn on below\nFind XDesk in the list and turn its switch on\nCome back to XDesk; it takes effect
Start Linux desktops with one tap
Run xdesk start yourself in Termux.
Tap Turn on below\nThe system asks once\nXDesk goes on by itself
Scan a Mac\'s QR code; the address works too
Add the Mac by address instead.
Tap Turn on below\nAllow the camera\nCome back to scan
Do Not Disturb switch on the external screen
The switch only tells you where to turn it on.
Tap Turn on below\nFind XDesk in the list and turn its switch on\nCome back to XDesk; it takes effect
Comes back by itself after the system stops it
After the system stops it, notifications may not come in until XDesk is opened.
Tap Open below\nTurn XDesk\'s autostart on\nIt is also under Settings › Apps › XDesk
USB debugging
Mac receiver over USB
The Mac receiver can reach the phone over the USB cable.
The Mac can still connect over Wi-Fi.
Tap Turn on below\nTurn on “USB debugging”\nCome back to XDesk
Wired web display
Over a USB cable, iPad and Mac only accept NCM, while Android tethers as RNDIS unless told otherwise.
USB tethering still works, but an iPad or Mac may not connect.
Tap Copy command below\nRun it on a computer with adb\nUnplug and plug the USB cable again
